carrier.edges: edge_id,u,v,positive integer bond dimension,optional source-weight provenance

entropy_policy.accountability: discarded mass, numerical rank, tolerance sweep, and Audenaert-style classical entropy continuity bound
entropy_policy.error_bound_scope: bounds hypothetical probability truncation only; does not certify floating-point SVD roundoff
entropy_policy.reported_entropy: includes every strictly positive numerical Schmidt probability
entropy_policy.tolerance_role: diagnostic numerical rank and hypothetical truncation accountability only

entropy_vector.anti_bypass: complete reachable entropy call graph imports no graph/cut module and accepts no graph/capacity/cut argument
entropy_vector.domain: all 2^|T| boundary subsets including empty and full
entropy_vector.method: dense numerical SVD of the normalized contracted boundary state

files.control_entropy_vectors_step1.csv: all four subset entropies for both injective cases and the gauge-related case
files.entropy_numerical_accountability_step1.c: small-Schmidt tolerance sweep, discarded mass, ranks, and error bounds
files.gauge_verifications_step1.csv: state and entropy residuals for every certified presentation move
files.legacy_seed_history_step1.csv: pinned pre-fix digests; read as history only and never used to construct tensors
files.seed_namespace_change_step1.csv: legacy coupled versus independent tensor seeds and entropy digests
files.step2_contract_requirements.md: verbatim reviewer contract for the next step
files.survivor_tractability_step1.csv: full-vector contraction census on all 13 P1-v3 survivors

numerical_scope: complex128 dense contraction and SVD; not exact arithmetic

tensor_families.seeded_random_complex: independent normalized complex Gaussian tensor at every vertex, deterministic SHA-derived local seeds
tensor_families.structured_copy: deterministic equality/copy tensor; equal incident dimensions required
